title: 第一卷 第7章 军中装备第一卷 第8章 起杀心
slug: 乱世加点从猎户到武圣只杀不赦
content_zh:
“等等。”
眼看着李毅他们就要离开，李二牛叫住了他们。
只见他脸色凝重，沉吟了片刻后，似是终于下定了某种决心。
“小毅，你们等我一会。”
说罢，李二牛从床底下拖出一个裹着厚布的长条物件。
他吹了吹上面的灰尘，打开后，竟然是一把黑得发亮的弓。
“二牛哥，这张弓？”
李毅心头一跳，他认得这把弓，是只有官兵才能配备的黑漆弓，虽然现在乱世，管控得没有那么严格，但是普通人想要买一把如此的弓箭，也是很是艰难。
本来李毅是打算去县城碰碰运气，看看能不能买到这样的一张。
实在不行就买麻背弓，这也是猎户的首选。
“小毅，这把弓，是我大哥留下的，本想让我建功立业，可现在我这身子骨......”
李二牛眼中闪过一丝不舍，最终还是递到了李毅面前，道：“你拿着，在你手里，它才能发挥出最大的作用。”
李毅没伸手，这弓很贵重，但是情谊更重，
“二牛哥，这可太贵重了，我不能要，而且这个是大狗哥留给你的。”
“少废话，你给我拿着。”
李二牛上前一步，抓住李毅的手，死死的把弓压在他的手上，道：“这个是我的心意，你必须给我拿着，我只有一个要求，赶紧生个带把的，我决不能让那些人吃绝户！”
听到这话，一旁刘芳害羞地低下了头。
李毅纠结片刻，看着二牛那双异常坚定的眼睛，郑重地点了点头。
李二牛脸上的皱纹这才舒展开来。
李毅拿起弓，细细观摩。

光是凭手上感受到的质感，就知道这是好东西。
现在的自己有三石的力量，普通的弓确实不够看，而这个弓弦紧绷，纹丝不动。弓臂在手中缓缓弯曲，没有吱呀的噪音，只有一种沉闷的、蓄势待发的力量感。
有了这张弓，定能将他的技能发挥得淋漓尽致。
陪着李二牛说了会话后，俩人便被李二牛赶了出去。
用他的话来说，与其在这陪他一个废人聊天，还不如赶紧回家造小人去。
早点生个孩子，继承他家的香火才是正事。
回程路上，刘芳一直低着头，小脸通红。
都快到家了，她才开口问道：“毅、毅哥，我们现在还去县城么？”
李毅点了点头道：“先回家，等中午吃了饭，我再去县城逛逛，买一些箭矢。”
“好。”
回到家，李月已经开始在熏猪肉。
content_en:
"Wait."
Seeing that Li Yi and the others were about to leave, Li Erniu stopped them.
His face was solemn, and after pondering for a moment, he seemed to have finally made up his mind.
"Xiao Yi, please wait for me for a while."
After that, Li Erniu dragged out a long object wrapped in thick cloth from under the bed.
He blew away the dust on it, and when he opened it, it turned out to be a shiny black bow.
"Brother Erniu, this bow?"
Li Yi's heart skipped a beat. He recognized this bow. It was a black lacquer bow that could only be equipped by officers and soldiers. Although in today's troubled times, control is not so strict, it is still very difficult for ordinary people to buy such a bow and arrow.
Originally, Li Yi planned to go to the county town to try his luck and see if he could buy such a piece.
If it doesn't work, just buy a hemp-backed bow, which is also the first choice for hunters.
"Xiao Yi, this bow was left by my eldest brother. I wanted to make a contribution to my career, but now my body is weak..."
A trace of reluctance flashed in Li Erniu's eyes, and he finally handed it to Li Yi and said: "You take it. Only in your hands can it play its greatest role."
Li Yi did not reach out. This bow is very valuable, but friendship is more important.
"Brother Erniu, this is too valuable. I can't take it. Besides, this is what Brother Big Dog left for you."
"Stop talking nonsense, just hold it for me."
Li Erniu stepped forward, grabbed Li Yi's hand, pressed the bow firmly on his hand, and said: "This is my wish, you must hold it for me. I only have one request, give birth to a baby with a handle quickly, I must not let those people die!"
Hearing this, Liu Fang lowered her head shyly.
Li Yi struggled for a moment, looked at Er Niu's extremely firm eyes, and nodded solemnly.
The wrinkles on Li Erniu's face relaxed.
Li Yi picked up the bow and looked at it carefully.
Just by the texture on my hands, I knew it was good stuff.
Now I have the power of three stones. An ordinary bow is really not enough, but this bowstring is tight and motionless. The bow arm slowly bent in the hand, making no squeaking noise, only a dull, ready-to-go feeling of power.
With this bow, he will be able to make full use of his skills.
After having a conversation with Li Erniu, the two of them were kicked out by Li Erniu.
In his words, instead of chatting with a useless person like him, it would be better to go home and make a little person.
It is important to have a child as soon as possible and inherit the legacy of his family.
On the way back, Liu Fang kept her head down, her face flushed.
She was almost home when she asked: "Yi, Brother Yi, are we still going to the county seat now?"
Li Yi nodded and said: "Go home first. After lunch, I will go shopping in the county and buy some arrows."
"Okay."
Back home, Li Yue had already started smoking pork.
